title: The SS Ourang Medan Mystery
hook: What silenced an entire ship's crew in one night?
headline: Ghost Ship That Stilled Its Crew

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: In May 1947 a Dutch freighter sent a distress call through fog near Jakarta.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: Radio operators recorded the crew shouting "We are dying" before silence.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: When rescuers boarded, they found bodies with no visible injuries, eyes open.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: Later analysis suggested carbon monoxide from a faulty exhaust may have caused rapid poisoning.

end.line: Could an unseen gas have silenced the whole crew?

description: A 1947 distress call led to a ghost ship mystery with no injuries found on board.

facts.claim: The distress call was reported in May 1947 near Jakarta, Indonesia.
Radio operators heard the crew shouting "We are dying" before silence.
Rescuers found bodies with no visible injuries and eyes open.
One theory suggests carbon monoxide poisoning from a faulty exhaust caused the deaths.
The vessel was a Dutch-registered freighter.

bad: contradicted: In May 1947 a Dutch freighter sent a distress call near Jakarta (spravne: June 1947, distress messages picked up by the City of Baltimore and the Silver Star in the Straits of Malacca)
